summary: Single-line text input with built-in label and supporting text; use for text, search, email, url, password, tel, number and date.

usage.text: The required, type, pattern, min, max, step, minlength and maxlength attributes feed validity. Whitespace-only text counts as missing when required. A readonly field is never reported invalid.
The change event fires when the native input commits: on blur after an edit, or on Enter.

a11y.text: An aria-describedby on the host is resolved against ids in the host's own root and applied to the inner input together with the supporting text, in browsers with ARIA element reflection.
